title: Dukkhasuttaṃ
text: 174 . Sāvatthinidānaṃ . Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘‘dukkhaṃ, dukkha’nti, bhante, vuccati. Katamaṃ nu kho, bhante, dukkha’’nti? ‘‘Rūpaṃ kho, rādha, dukkhaṃ, vedanā dukkhā, saññā dukkhā, saṅkhārā dukkhā, viññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ. Evaṃ passaṃ…pe… nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātī’’ti. Pañcamaṃ.
